match.userMessage:
Use Image 1 as the starting frame.
For the first six seconds, use a smooth backward truck in front of Image 2 as she strides toward camera. Starting with the lipstick already open in her raised hand and the tote in the other, she snaps the tube shut, slips it into the tote without breaking stride, then immediately doubles back toward the radiator shelf to retrieve the phone. Keep her centered and her movements precise.

At six seconds, cut to the stairwell. Use a smooth pan following Image 2 as she descends two flights at a brisk, controlled pace with one hand sliding along the rail. She catches her reflection in the wired-glass window, turns her chin toward it with a small amused reaction, then continues downward toward the exit.

Her tote swings lightly with each step, the rail hand glides naturally, and alternating shafts of sunlight sweep across her face and the concrete as she passes each landing.

overall_soundscape: quiet apartment hallway ambience transitioning to distant city noise and stairwell echo. lipstick cap click, brisk footsteps on hallway flooring, phone lifted from the radiator shelf, footsteps on concrete stairs, hand sliding along the metal rail. No BGM, no music. Generate only dialogue, environmental sounds, and action sounds.

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the stylish blonde woman shown in <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>, wearing dark sunglasses, red lipstick, a black turtleneck, black trousers, and carrying a beige tote bag.

summary:
[keyframe completion + reference generation] The video begins on <Picture 1> as <Subject 1> packs her lipstick and retrieves her phone in the apartment hallway, then cuts to her briskly descending a sunlit stairwell.

retention_analysis:
<Picture 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - Acts as the initial frame of the sequence.
<Picture 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): attribute_transfer - Preserves identity, styling, and clothing details for <Subject 1>.
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - Retains appearance, hair, sunglasses, and tote bag across both shots.

detailed_description:
Cinematic natural lighting with warm hallway tones transitioning to high-contrast stairwell daylight.

[Shot 1] Beginning precisely on <Picture 1>, the camera performs a smooth backward Tracking Shot at moderate speed. <Subject 1> strides forward, snaps the open lipstick tube shut, and drops it into her beige tote bag without breaking stride. She then smoothly pivots back toward the radiator shelf, cleanly grabs her smartphone from the wooden ledge, and turns toward the corridor exit.
Sound: Sharp plastic click of the lipstick cap, light fabric rustling, rhythmic footsteps on hallway flooring, and the gentle clatter of the phone lifted off the shelf.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to the concrete stairwell. The camera executes a smooth Pan Right with medium Tracking Shot following <Subject 1> as she descends the stairs at a brisk, controlled pace. Her beige tote swings lightly while her right hand slides smoothly down the black handrail. Alternating shafts of sunlight illuminate her face and the steps. Passing a wired-glass landing window, she catches her reflection, offers a subtle amused smirk, and continues downward toward the exit.
Sound: Reverberant footsteps echoing on concrete steps, the continuous glide of a palm across a metal rail, and faint distant exterior city noise.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet residential hallway ambience shifting to an echoing concrete stairwell with distant urban hum. Diegetic effects include a lipstick cap click, footstep impacts, phone pick-up handling, and hand friction against a metal rail.
